name: shadowpool
description: ShadowPool — an on-chain dark pool for FAssets on Flare. This root package builds and runs the whole product as ONE service: the node (matching enclave + chain relay + API) also serves the statically-exported frontend, so `npm install && npm start` at the repo root is a complete deployment. Uses only npm, since hosts vary in what package managers they provide.

scripts.postinstall: npm run build:node && npm run build:web
scripts.build: npm run build:node && npm run build:web
scripts.build:node: cd services && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.build:web: cd web && rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json .next out && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
